{{< include latex-macros/macros.qmd >}}

::: remark

Probability and statistics count with the integers and natural numbers
and measure with the real numbers.
This page defines those number systems.
It also defines the words that sort their members:
even and odd integers, and rational and irrational real numbers.
Finally, it defines divisibility, [primes](#def-prime) and congruence,
and the [factorial](#def-factorial) of a [non-negative integer](#def-nonnegative-integers).

:::
